description: This file contains test cases for the 'Scope' functionalities within the TensorFlow Go API, including sub-scope management, control dependencies, device placement, finalization, and example usages.

methods.name: TestScopeSubScope
methods.description: Tests the sub-scope creation and naming conventions within Scope.

methods.name: TestScopeSubScopeErrors
methods.description: Verifies error propagation when creating sub-scopes and pushing invalid operations.

methods.name: TestControlDependencies
methods.description: Tests control dependency handling within the Scope, especially how dependencies are maintained and executed.

methods.name: TestDevice
methods.description: Tests setting device placement within the scope and its effect on operations.

methods.name: TestScopeFinalize
methods.description: Verifies the effect of finalizing the scope on subsequent operations and error states.

methods.name: TestMultipleGeneratedOps
methods.description: Tests generation of multiple placeholder operations and their successful finalization.

methods.name: TestScopeWithGraph
methods.description: Tests creating a scope linked to an existing graph and adding operations to it.

methods.name: Example
methods.description: Provides an example of creating a computation graph to perform matrix multiplication in TensorFlow.

methods.name: ExampleScope_SubScope
methods.description: Demonstrates creation of sub-scopes and naming conventions for operations.
